coverage_decision: All main-text figures, tables, and named workflows are represented. Pure bibliography pages are not condensed as evidence; the transparency statement and availability material on page 13 are included.
omissions: References are not summarized item-by-item because they are provenance infrastructure rather than primary extraction targets. No supplement/appendix is present in the retrieved PDF.
qa_flags: Two numerical reconciliation issues are carried into appraisal: Table III reports 34 above-ceiling human rungs while its narrative split reports 23+13=36; Table III reports 242 AI activity-class counts while the transparency statement/Figure 6 reports 206 Claude Code-associated activities.
